entries.root_cause: Candidate build/materialization was circularly modeled as a final-gate role/attempt.
entries.closed_contract: CandidateMaterializationV1 and CampaignFreezeV1 separate one-time materialization from every final-gate attempt; failure poisons source SHA/tree and same-SHA rebuild is rejected.

entries.root_cause: One candidate-bound evidence model could not represent P00-P04 and predecessor admission before candidate bytes existed.
entries.closed_contract: PreflightEvidenceIndexV1 and CandidateEvidenceIndexV1 are disjoint; wire stores evidence_root_id plus logical root-relative POSIX path, byte size, and SHA-256 only.

entries.root_cause: Test ownership lacked a deterministic migration from the immutable 2,214-node baseline.
entries.closed_contract: Exact reviewed 43 add + 1 move + 69 delete delta deterministically derives checkpoint manifests; unknown, duplicate, or unplanned nodes reject before body execution.

entries.root_cause: The previous cutover could delete the only collection filter owner with root tests/conftest.py.
entries.closed_contract: pytest_plugin.py permanently owns pytest_collection_modifyitems before and after P15; root conftest is a temporary compatibility seam only.

entries.root_cause: Fault denominator, input schemas, and violation-code inventory were not closed enough to implement without new decisions.
entries.closed_contract: Exact 20-category/45-entry candidate-bound catalogue, finite 68-code inventory, NodeObservation, consumer scan, retirement, required-context, and related schemas are closed before Product implementation.

entries.root_cause: StopReturn could not truthfully represent both pre-mutation and post-mutation stops.
entries.closed_contract: StopReturnV1 requires scope impact, owners/actions, changed and external surfaces, rollback/recovery disposition, and keeps automatic_rollback_performed=false.

acceptance_note: Authored closure is not a review pass. The same Red session must independently return review_status=pass with P0=0 and P1=0; P2 remains record-only.
